explanation: The 1939 film made them ruby slippers to show off its Technicolor. In the book they are silver and belonged to the Wicked Witch of the East.

claims.text: In L. Frank Baum's The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900), Dorothy's magic shoes are silver.
In the 1900 novel the shoes are not ruby red, gold or emerald green.
The 1939 MGM film changed the silver shoes to ruby slippers, a change usually credited to showing off its Technicolor.
In the novel, the silver shoes had belonged to the Wicked Witch of the East.
